step_by_step_reasoning: We identify nodes from the whiteboard drawing: the legacy data center containing general environment, apps, and database; AWS services for routing, compute, and databases. We map Route 53 to the 'Router' icon. We trace data migration flows from on-premise nodes to AWS services, and routing pathways from the Router to various targets.

graph.name: Talabat Migrating On-Premise Workloads to EKS, Lambda, and Beanstalk
graph.notes: Architectural overview of Talabat's digital transformation, migrating on-premise applications and databases to AWS using EKS, Lambda, Beanstalk, Aurora, and EC2 with Route 53 managing traffic shifting.
